finalText:
I went through all 380 commits and the 128 merged PRs. Most really was noise: dependency bumps, file moves, renamed internal types, dead code cleanup, test and CI tweaks. I found 13 things people would actually notice, and wrote them into `CHANGELOG.md` as a 4.2.0 section, same shape as before.

One new feature: failed webhook deliveries now retry automatically with backoff, instead of dropping after one try. The rest are fixes: expired tokens now return 401 instead of 403, four different list endpoints no longer error on a null cursor, trailing slashes stopped doubling up in two places, empty allowlists stopped erroring in three places, trace ids survive retries, latency metrics report the right units, a duplicate header got dropped, the database client stopped logging full request bodies, and the HTTP client now cleans up its timer and connection pool properly. No breaking changes this time.

Worth a look before you publish: the raw commit log had a several-week gap between the last commit (2026-06-17) and today. I used tomorrow's date, 2026-08-23, for the release, same as the other entries in the file.
